images_plugin_description: Attach images to a message with a button, by pasting them or by dropping them on the message box. Mannie shrinks them before the model reads them.
images_error_too_large: {name} is larger than {limit} MiB, so it was not added.
images_error_too_wide: {name} is wider or taller than {maxSide} pixels, so it was not added.
images_error_too_many_pixels: {name} has more than {maxMegapixels} megapixels, so it was not added.
images_error_cannot_shrink: Mannie could not make {name} small enough to send.
images_error_unsupported_format: {name} is not a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image.
images_error_unreadable: {name} is damaged or incomplete, so Mannie could not read it.
images_error_file_unreadable: {name} could not be read. Check that it still exists and that you may open it.
images_error_not_found: {name} is no longer available. Choose it again.
images_error_dialog_failed: The file dialog could not open. Paste or drop the images instead.
images_refusal_not_found: It was removed, or Images was turned off after you added it.
